description: This file contains functions and types for configuring and resolving Matrix chat room and user allowlists, including normalization, filtering, and target resolution logic.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixUserLookupEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a raw user lookup string by removing 'matrix:' and 'user:' prefixes and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixRoomLookupEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a raw room lookup string by removing 'matrix:', 'room:', or 'channel:' prefixes and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: filterResolvedMatrixAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Filters a list of entries to include only valid Matrix user IDs or the wildcard '*'.

methods.name: sanitizeMatrixRoomUserAllowlists
methods.description: Sanitizes the allowlists in room configurations by filtering user entries.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMonitorUserEntries
methods.description: Resolves a list of user entries to their Matrix IDs, handling direct matches and pending resolutions.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMonitorUserAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves and canonicalizes a list of user allowlist entries, filtering unresolved entries.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMonitorRoomsConfig
methods.description: Resolves and sanitizes room configurations, including room ID/alias resolution and user allowlist resolution.
